reader_notes: 'Det blev tvärtom' in the opening slightly overstates what the article actually settles on — the conclusion is that neither tidiness nor mess decides, but whether the plots connect. The hedge 'fast inte riktigt så enkelt' rescues it, and no question depends on the distinction.
'En prydligt gles lott med öppningar i staketet' is a compressed phrase that needs a second read to parse (tidy plot, sparse fencing); everything else in the passage reads cleanly.
